parameters.name: Coverage
parameters.description:
The protection region. If this parameter is not specified, the default value global is used. Valid values:

- domestic: the Chinese mainland.

- overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

- global: global.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

>The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](url) operation.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.
